name: PAX Unplugged
blurb: An annual tabletop-gaming convention at the Pennsylvania Convention Center in Philadelphia, with panels, an expo hall and tournaments.

editions.evidence: Philly subpage JSON-LD Event 'PAX Unplugged Philly' 2026-12-04 10:00 -> 2026-12-06 17:00 @ Pennsylvania Convention Center; page text: 'Show Location Pennsylvania Convention Center 1101 Arch Street Philadelphia, PA 19107 ... Friday, December 4 ... Sunday, December 6'

notes: Brand now runs two shows: Philadelphia (this file, Dec 4-6 2026) and a new Houston edition (June 25-27 2027, 'more details coming soon') -- per the multi-city rule the Houston show is left for its own file, not included here. The special-guests page's 5 current guests (Elizabeth Hargrave, Jerry Holkins, Kris Straub, Laura Stringer, Lynnvander Studios) were found as gtID guest-profile links in the page's link list, but the page renders guest photos in a way extract.mjs's image/background-image scan could not capture (tried twice, once with a 4s extra wait) -- no usable image candidate exists for any of them, so all 5 are recorded in textOnlyGuests rather than guessed picks. Laura Stringer and Lynnvander Studios were confirmed via one web search each (Laura Stringer: Penny Arcade-affiliated, board-game topics; Lynnvander Studios: a board-game design studio with a recurring PAX presence); the other three are well-known figures (Wingspan's designer; Penny Arcade's two co-creators).
